## Today's Java DSA challenge

**Clone Graph** · Pattern: Graph traversal and map

Handle cycles with a visited-to-clone map.

Practice link: https://leetcode.com/problems/clone-graph/

## 90-minute plan

1. **10 min — Recall:** write yesterday's pattern and one mistake from memory.
2. **35 min — Solve:** attempt the challenge in Java without looking at a solution. State the brute-force approach first.
3. **15 min — Explain:** give time and space complexity and justify the data structure.
4. **15 min — Test:** write normal, boundary, empty/minimum and duplicate/adversarial cases.
5. **10 min — Review:** compare with an editorial only after a genuine attempt; note why your approach works.
6. **5 min — Log:** record minutes, outcome, blocker and whether you can re-solve unaided in 3–7 days.

## Definition of done

- Code compiles and passes edge cases.
- You can explain the invariant and complexity without notes.
- Add one mistake or lesson to the dashboard study log.
